**▶ Online: https://radoslawo81.github.io/WebSpectrometer2.0/** (Chrome / Edge, no installation)

**WebSpectrometer2.0** is now a standalone project (previously the fork radoslawo81/WebSpectrometer). Everything runs locally in the browser. Polish description: [docs/README.pl.md](https://github.com/radoslawo81/WebSpectrometer2.0/blob/main/docs/README.pl.md)

### Highlights / Najważniejsze
- **Spectral response calibration** with a choice of source: incandescent, halogen 230 V / 12 V, illuminant A, custom temperature, or a reference spectrum file (e.g. the Sun) – *kalibracja czułości z wyborem źródła*
- **2nd / 3rd-order ghosts** flagged instead of misidentified, each order can be switched off – *duchy wyższych rzędów*
- **Band bar** UVC / UVB / UVA / colours / IR under the graph – *pasek zakresów*
- **UV-A share**, CCT and CRI only for white light – *udział UV-A, CCT tylko dla światła białego*
- Light quality, transmission, absorbance, automatic wavelength calibration, line identification, HDR, time log, report, Polish UI (from 1.x)

Full list: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/radoslawo81/WebSpectrometer2.0/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

### Offline package
`WebSpectrometer2.0-v2.0.0.zip` is the built site. Browsers do not run it from `file://`; unzip and serve the folder with any static server, e.g.:

```
cd WebSpectrometer2.0-v2.0.0
python3 -m http.server 8000
```
then open http://localhost:8000 (camera access works on `localhost`).
